scopeChangeReason: Codex host-B findings from the REVIEW quorum required two contract updates that acknowledgements cannot legally cover: (1) F-012 (concurrent appendUsageRecord hash-chain race) is only correctly fixable at the single-writer choke point core/usage-ledger/writer.ts, previously in explicitExcludes because no writer change was anticipated at PLAN - moved to allowedModify; record/assemble/summary/diagnostics stay excluded (no schema/semantics change). (2) F-014 (usage_sweep --out bypassing read-only gates) is fixed in resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass which lives in cli/ownership-gate.ts (same file as the precedent --write boundary rules) - added to allowedModify. Story regressed REVIEW->DEV solely for this contract amendment (scope_contract_set is PLAN/DEV-only) and returns to REVIEW immediately; both fixes are finding-bound, smoke-covered (host-run 42, usage-sweep 17), and already reviewed by four lanes plus codex in subsequent rounds.

acknowledgements.reason: Codex host-B verified finding F-012 (cross_host_review B-70e9-xhr-r5): concurrent appendUsageRecord read-last-hash->append races corrupt the ledger hash chain under host_run default concurrency. The only correct fix point is the single-writer choke point in writer.ts (mkdir cross-process lock over the minimal critical section, bounded wait + stale reclaim, skip-not-corrupt on timeout via the existing throw->seam-fail-open path). record/assemble/summary/diagnostics remain untouched; commit bc966e3247 demonstrates the race against the old writer and proves the fix with a 6-process parallel chain-verification smoke.

F-014 (codex host-B, r7) requires the dynamic ownership rule for usage_sweep --out to live in resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass, which is defined in cli/ownership-gate.ts (the exact file where the precedent --write boundary rules for plan_skeleton/evidence_refresh/live_smoke_transcript/delivery_context_pack reside; a 20-line mirror addition). writer.ts re-acknowledged at the current head for the F-012 cross-process append lock (original ack scope-ack:1 bound to head bc966e3247; unchanged since, but the head advanced through review-metadata and F-013/F-014/F-015 commits). Both edits are finding-bound, smoke-covered, and reviewed by all four lanes plus codex host-B in subsequent rounds.

F-022 (concept lane, round 14): one check label in this pre-existing smoke still asserted the old recordDispatchFinal void-return contract after F-021 changed it to DispatchFinalStatus; commit d638945a8a updates only that label (+ one appended:false status assertion for label/body consistency, +4/-2). Out-of-contract test file; finding-bound minimal edit.

F-028 (codex host-B, r17): usage_sweep needed read-only classification at the CLI activity/hook layer; the classification predicate lives in cli/activity-policy.ts and its four gating consumers live in cli-engine.ts - a static-set-only fix would regress the --out write path (hooks would stop running on a write). Finding-bound minimal wiring (commit 81c5bc42ea); behavior byte-identical for every other command, asserted by cli-surface/command-catalog/ownership-contract smokes.
